lines.zh: 我拖着宽大的身子往前。
lines.en: I drag my wide body forward.
My belly nearly touches the ground.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都压平了。
lines.en: The grass flattens where I pass.

lines.zh: 我每挪一寸都碾碎土块。
lines.en: Every inch I shift crushes clods of earth.
I shift past a boulder.
I glance around.

lines.zh: 松土在我腹下往两边翻。
lines.en: Loose soil rolls aside beneath my belly.
I stop at the cave mouth.
My back is wider than two doors.

lines.zh: 我这副宽身子，挪得很慢。
lines.en: This broad body of mine moves slowly.
I circle that clearing.
I'm not planning to chase anyone.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面听远处的动静。
lines.en: I press to the ground and listen far off.
Dirt clings to my belly.
I lay without moving.
Wind blows over. I don't care.
I blink my small eyes.
The meadow is all quiet.
My breathing is loud.
A layer of dust has settled.
Grass sways beside me.
I'll lie a little longer.
You're standing beside me.
I don't even need to look up.
Your legs are in front of me.
I sniffed at you.
You have no hostility.
Good.

lines.zh: 我整个身子转过来，地都在震。
lines.en: My whole body turns, and the ground shakes.
Don't sit on me.
I'm not a stone.
I can't be bothered.
You hit my back.

lines.zh: 我这副身板几乎挖得穿地。
lines.en: This bulk of mine could dig through the ground.
It's only on the thick hide.
My back is harder than armor.
Dirt falls off my back.
Your strength will not move me.
Your strength isn't much.
I can still lie here.
That one landed on my back.
You woke me up.
Put that a little farther away.
That little thing isn't worth chewing.
Your offering is too small.
These don't appeal to me.
I shifted a little.
That smell doesn't interest me.
Your raised arm will ache.
Just put it down.
I may not even eat it.
Walk away first.
You hit my flank.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的背甲，弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my back plates and bounced off.
You're the one who bounced.
I'm too wide for the path.
You squeezed past my side.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，土扬起来。
lines.en: We collided and dust flew up.
Your foot sank into the soil.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边缓缓蹭过去。
lines.en: I slide slowly past your feet.
My back scraped a tree trunk.
The tree shook a few times.
I don't even want to lift my eyelids.
I'm this wide. Who could put up with it?
I spend most of my time asleep.
I still have work to do in the soil.
I don't plan to find a mate.
This land is enough for me.
The sun feels nice.
I close my eyes.
Don't wake me.
I yawn.
I don't even want to move.
It's right by your foot.
I stretched a claw out.
Too far. Can't reach.
Pick it up on your way.
I don't really need that.

lines.zh: 我用前肢把它拨进土里。
lines.en: I shovel it into the soil with my forelimbs.
It's buried in the soil.
I don't plan to dig.
Leave it there.
You raised something at me.
I lifted my eyes and saw.
I didn't want to move.
You insist on this.

lines.zh: 我这么大一坨，站起来很费时间。
lines.en: This bulk takes time to stand.
A hollow remains in the ground.
I turn toward you.
It takes me a long while to rise.
Getting up takes me a while.
Think it over in that time.
I raise my heavy head.

lines.zh: 七格半宽的我，眼睛却小。
lines.en: Seven and a half blocks wide, and my eyes are small.
You've backed ten paces off.
I rest after every step.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地就震一下。
lines.en: Every step I take shakes the ground.
This isn't the outcome I wanted.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下的土层里跟着。
lines.en: I follow in the soil beneath your feet.
I dig faster than you can take a detour.
Run as far as you like. I'll still get there.
There's a slope ahead.
Climbing will slow you.

lines.zh: 我横过来能挡住整条路。
lines.en: Turned sideways, I block the whole path.

lines.zh: 你朝松土这边看了一眼。
lines.en: You glanced toward the loose soil.
I haven't sped up.
Mud gurgles deep in my throat.
Your steps are getting messy.
I stop at the foot of the slope.
Going up doesn't favor me.
I wait at the bottom of the slope.

lines.zh: 这片空地没有别的出口。
lines.en: This clearing has no other exit.
Seven blocks wide, I shift sideways.
You've backed toward the trees.
Trees won't stop my bulk.
I'm right here.
I raise my front half a little.
A few steps of ground left.
I raise a forepaw and slam it down.
The soil scattered.
You dodged aside.
My head swings into you.
You slid away from the impact.
I press down and the soil squeezes out.
But you can't dodge the second.

lines.zh: 我整条身子横着碾过去。
lines.en: I grind across sideways with my whole body.
You're squashed against the stone.
I stopped.
Can you still push yourself up?

lines.zh: 七米半宽的我，转身都难。
lines.en: Seven and a half meters wide — even turning is hard.
My shoulder grinds past.
You're rolled over by the shove.
I raise the other forepaw.
This one lands beside you.
Clods of earth hit you.
I lower my head and butt you.
You can't back away far.
And that's the end of it.
I shift out from behind the earth mound.
The ground groans under me.
I'm wide as a wall.
You look small before me.
I move sluggishly.
The soil here is soft.
I stop to catch my breath.
I'm not coming for you.
I plow up the soil, only passing through.
You'd better not start anything either.
I sniff the soil on your boot soles.

lines.zh: 我从松土里拱出半个身。
lines.en: I heave half my body out of loose soil.

lines.zh: 火烧在我的背上，烫得厉害。
lines.en: Fire on my back burns fiercely.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，我压塌一片草。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and flattened the grass.

lines.zh: 水只到我的肚子，可我不会游。
lines.en: Water reaches my belly, but I can't swim.

lines.zh: 爆炸把周围的土都掀起来了。
lines.en: The blast threw the surrounding soil up.
An arrow stuck in my back.

lines.zh: 一道光打过我的皮，很烫。
lines.en: A flash crossed my hide. Hot.

lines.zh: 我懒得去找吃的，越来越轻。
lines.en: Too lazy to forage. I'm getting lighter.

lines.zh: 雷声把我从睡里惊起来。
lines.en: Thunder startled me out of sleep.
No soil to lie on here.
